productDefects: Remote external-agent inventory relied on a fixed startup delay instead of receiver-driven snapshot and reconnect ordering.
Captured directory environments replayed PROMPT_COMMAND without its non-exported shell function, producing an immediate broken prompt.
Remote Vim shell commands inherited the remote home directory rather than the opened project cwd.
TCP DAP accepted an SSH forward before the remote adapter owned the destination, allowing a reset connection to become the session transport.
testHarnessDefects: Live TCP port allocation sent python -c source to SSH without one remote-shell quoting boundary.
ACP project evidence was initially coupled to one provider transcript shape; an interim union-based correction was later found capable of accepting unrelated prompt-shaped fragments.
The terminal UAT fixture returned from signal.pause after SIGWINCH instead of remaining alive for Ctrl-C.
The fake TCP adapter emitted an invalid empty ThreadsResponse.
The terminal resize oracle compared only the first and last widths instead of requiring distinct observed widths.
The synthetic directory environment was authorized after project open, so Zed had already cached the pre-authorization environment.
The cleanup census matched its own remote observer ancestors because their argv contained the fixture path.
The standalone ACP canary required an agent-computed digest and cwd transcript instead of proving the exact sentinel path and observed file bytes.
The ephemeral-sentinel cleanup closed its ownership file descriptor too early, allowing Linux to reuse the inode after route-driven replacement and falsely classify the replacement as owned.
processDefects: Representative Mac and Intrepid ACP routes were accepted as coverage for independently selectable picker entries.
Direct ACP protocol execution was allowed to impersonate the installed Zed picker and session launch boundary.
fixedDuringRun: Replaced fixed-delay external-agent inventory with request/response snapshots, rejoin refresh, and stale-response suppression.
Added a RED SSH argv-shape regression and one shell-quoted remote command.

Replaced transcript-shape evidence with an exact same-call sentinel path plus observed file bytes, or an exact project-confined ACP client read; prompt echo and unrelated split calls remain non-green.
Kept the terminal fixture alive across resize until the intended interrupt.
Removed captured PROMPT_COMMAND before explicit terminal or task settings are applied.
Anchored remote Vim shell execution to the opened project directory.
Tagged header/body disconnect I/O errors and replayed initialize once, within the existing SSH/TCP timeout; stdio and non-SSH DAP keep the ordinary request path.
Made the fake adapter return a protocol-valid empty threads list.
Required two distinct observed terminal widths rather than a brittle first-versus-last comparison.
Authorized the exact synthetic direnv before opening the installed app.
Excluded only the observer's reuse-safe ancestor identities from cleanup census while retaining sibling/descendant residue detection.
Retained marker-only, prompt-echo, permission, timeout, and cleanup negatives.

Pinned the original ephemeral-sentinel file descriptor for the full route lifetime, compared that live identity with the pathname immediately before any unlink, and refused all unlinking while process-group cleanup remained unproven.
Separated every-route protocol evidence from installed assembled-product picker evidence and required one direct representative per stable execution class.

Replaced the prompt-visible digest contract with exact same-call path plus observed sentinel-content proof or a project-confined ACP client read; prompt echo and unrelated split calls remain non-green.
